`[EFFORT …]` on a wiki page shows estimate, logged, remaining, forecast and variance per task with totals, for the matching tasks. Done when the macro renders live, uses the filters of [[GENBEYA-45]], and says how many tasks lack an estimate or have unreadable time log lines instead of presenting a partial sum as precise. See [[Design/Planning#the-numbers]].

Built on `feature/planning-prototype`: `[EFFORT]`, with totals and what is missing.

- [x] Engine: the numbers per task and the totals, with spec tests (remaining is never estimate − logged)
- [x] Renderer: a table, with totals per epic or milestone
- [x] Missing and unreadable data shown as such
- [x] Logged effort once [[GENBEYA-48]] is done; until then estimate and remaining
- [x] VS Code preview
- [x] Document in [[Guide/Wiki]]
